# Locations

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List locations

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/locations`

Retrieve a paginated list of locations with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: parent, children, storageCategory, warehouse, company, creator | `parent,storageCategory` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by | `architecto` |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by location name | `Stock` |
| `filter[full_name]` | string | No | Filter by full location name | `WH/Stock` |
| `filter[type]` | string | No | Filter by location types | `internal` |
| `filter[barcode]` | string | No | Filter by barcode | `LOC-01` |
| `filter[parent_id]` | string | No | Filter by parent location IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[storage_category_id]` | string | No | Filter by storage category IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[warehouse_id]` | string | No | Filter by warehouse IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[company_id]` | string | No | Filter by company IDs | `architecto` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-created_at` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/locations?include=parent%2CstorageCategory&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=Stock&filter%5Bfull_name%5D=WH%2FStock&filter%5Btype%5D=internal&filter%5Bbarcode%5D=LOC-01&filter%5Bparent_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Bstorage_category_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Bwarehouse_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=architecto&sort=-created_at" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",

});

console.log(data);
```

## Create location

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/locations`

Create a new location

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Location name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `parent_id` | integer | No | Parent location ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `description` | string | No | Location notes. |
| `type` | string | Yes | Location type. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `storage_category_id` | integer | No | Storage category ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `is_scrap` | boolean | No | Mark as scrap location. |
| `is_dock` | boolean | No | Mark as dock location. |
| `is_replenish` | boolean | No | Mark as replenish location. |
| `cyclic_inventory_frequency` | integer | No | Cycle counting frequency in days. Must be at least 0. |
| `barcode` | string | No | Barcode for the location. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/locations" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "Aisle A / Shelf 1",
  "parent_id": 5,
  "description": "Reserved for raw materials.",
  "type": "internal",
  "company_id": 1,
  "storage_category_id": 3,
  "is_scrap": false,
  "is_dock": false,
  "is_replenish": true,
  "cyclic_inventory_frequency": 30,
  "barcode": "LOC-A1"
}'
```

```python [Python]
data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

## Force delete location

<Badge type="tip" text="DELETE" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/locations/{id}/force`

Permanently delete a location

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The location ID |




::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X DELETE "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/locations/{id}/force" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/locations/{id}/force", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('DELETE', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/locations/{id}/force', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/locations/{id}/force"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.delete(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="200" />

```json
{
  "message": "Location permanently deleted successfully."
}
```

::: details Error response — 401

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated."
}
```

:::
